claimUnderTest: Untrusted or inexact payroll adjustment amounts cannot be displayed as authoritative, reviewed, or released by the Vector client.

observed.invariant: Non-authoritative currency context cannot create payroll authority.
Unsafe minor-unit integers cannot be displayed or reviewed.
Unknown amounts disable both review and release controls.
Direct client action handlers independently refuse unknown review and release.
Valid authoritative EUR and GBP evidence retains the review route.
Adjacent leave-balance and attendance-time-zone safeguards remain intact.

residualRisk: The authenticated API and stored adjustment contract have not independently enforced currency, minor-unit exponent, safe-integer bounds, tenant scope, revision or separation-of-duties.
Exact Node 22.23.2 packaged execution, saved-state readback, audit linkage, restart continuity and exported payroll reconciliation are not proved for this candidate.
requiredNextTest: Attack the authenticated payroll-adjustment API with missing, mismatched and unsafe amount provenance, then execute the exact packaged correction-to-export journey with persisted state, audit, restart and independent reconciliation.
